patches.summary: Hand-evolved after the original 2026-05-19 print through three weeks of real-account daily use
details: Added match_quality (strict/loose) reporting to add --json, with exit 11 and --allow-loose gate for loose FTS matches
Added Playwright checkout helper (checkout-helper/amazon-checkout.mjs) for cart writes and full checkout; static POSTs are rejected by Amazon's bot detection
Added exit 9 manual_required path with deeplink JSON field for CAPTCHA/sign-in gates
Added defaults set/show for card label + last-4 surfaced in checkout confirmations
Added history sync (walks /your-orders), auth paste fallback when Keychain denies kooky, and doctor reachability report
Hardened cart parsing against silently-dropped items-of-interest adds (add_failed reason surfaces instead of false success)
